name: Aeroacoustic Grazing Flow Benchmark
description: Provides measured benchmark data for evaluation and validation of aeroacoustic propagation codes under grazing flow conditions.
evaluation_method: error metrics (e.g., RMSE, SPL difference, spectral error)
general_score_metric: RMSE / spectral error of predicted acoustic pressure / SPL
reputation: A domain-specific experimental benchmark well regarded in the aeroacoustics community for validating propagation codes under grazing-flow conditions.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on experimental measurements; limited to aeroacoustics experts, susceptible to measurement noise and calibration differences, and primarily used for numerical code validation rather than ML benchmarking.
